[[The Falls (NPC)|The Falls]] is a group of large waterfalls located deep within the [[Maguuma Jungle]]. It is the entrance to [[Zinn]]'s [[Secret Underground Lair]].

==Locations==
*[[Maguuma Jungle]]
**{{NPC location|The Falls}}

==Dialogue==
If [[M.O.X.]] is not in your [[party]]:
:''"Water cascades over the rocks into a pool so deep you can't see the bottom."''
:{{x}} '''I'll be on my way.'''

If M.O.X. is in your party:
:''"This must be it. Zinn's picture clearly shows the falls. Only one way forward: jump. Do you jump?"''
:'''{{yes}} Take a deep breath and dive over the edge.''' (Sent to Zinn's Secret Underground Lair)
:'''{{no|ingame}} I can't swim.'''
